limiar: Youden na validacao, no melhor checkpoint
train_transform:
Compose(
    Grayscale(num_output_channels=3)
    PadToSquare()
    RandomResizedCrop(size=(224, 224), scale=(0.7, 1.0), ratio=(0.85, 1.15), interpolation=bilinear, antialias=True)
    RandomHorizontalFlip(p=0.5)
    RandomAffine(degrees=[-15.0, 15.0], translate=(0.05, 0.05), scale=(0.9, 1.1))
    ColorJitter(brightness=(0.7, 1.3), contrast=(0.7, 1.3), saturation=None, hue=None)
    RandomApply(
    p=0.3
    GaussianBlur(kernel_size=(5, 5), sigma=(0.1, 1.5))
)
    ToTensor()
    SpeckleNoise(std=0.1, p=0.3)
    Normalize(mean=[0.485, 0.456, 0.406], std=[0.229, 0.224, 0.225])
    RandomErasing(p=0.25, scale=(0.02, 0.1), ratio=(0.3, 3.3), value=0, inplace=False)
)
eval_transform:
Compose(
    Grayscale(num_output_channels=3)
    PadToSquare()
    Resize(size=(224, 224), interpolation=bilinear, max_size=None, antialias=True)
    ToTensor()
    Normalize(mean=[0.485, 0.456, 0.406], std=[0.229, 0.224, 0.225])
)
scheduler: ReduceLROnPlateau(mode=min sobre val_loss, factor=0.5, patience=3, min_lr=1e-7)
